title: fix: address review findings on base diff error handling and client exceptions
prompt:
fix: address review findings on base diff error handling and client exceptions

- Prevent fallback to unstaged diff when base_ref diff execution fails
- Return None and record error on update-ref failure during baseline snapshot
- Surface diff inspection and untracked file errors in DiffSummary
- Catch httpx.InvalidURL during LLM ping probe to return failure cleanly
- Wrap unexpected CLI LLM exceptions into LLMClientError for heuristic fallback
- Catch ValueError on command execution in runner and config synchronization
- Report failed git ls-files as DEAD-REF-UNVERIFIED and group by rule ID
- Add unit tests covering base diff failures, unreadable diffs, invalid URLs, and CLI exceptions

Files changed: guard/core/config.py, guard/core/diff_inspector.py, guard/core/llm_client.py, guard/core/removal_check.py, guard/hooks/runner.py, tests/test_error_paths.py
